traceMode.description: Trace strategy. Use "inherit" to keep the active OTEL trace, or "split" to create a new (Langfuse) trace for this LLM call.

traceId.description: Optional explicit (Langfuse) trace ID for split mode. Reuse the same value to group multiple LLM calls in one (Langfuse) trace.

traceName.description: Display name used as root span name for the Langfuse trace. This does not control grouping.

spanName.description: Name for the LLM span. This is forwarded to Vercel telemetry as functionId.

sessionId.description: Optional Langfuse session identifier to group related (Langfuse) traces (e.g. chat thread or job run).

langfuseOriginalPrompt.description: The original prompt that was used to generate the response. (Use prompt.toJSON())
